statements.t: We look forward to building on our recent momentum as we work to establish dabogratinib as a potentially transformative therapy for patients with FGFR3-driven diseases.”
Together with existing cash resources, the financing is expected to support execution of the Company's dabogratinib 3x3 strategy, as well as ongoing research and development activities, through 2030.
Following its September 2026 financing, the Company expects its current financial resources to fund planned operations through 2030.
